B.6. Captain Hunter. P.F.66074

As spoken - the enclosed letter was received by us from the Governor of Brixton prison. I should be grateful if you would arrange for it to be posted as soon as possible in such a way that it will have either a Brixton postmark or an illegible one.

F.3.E.
2.8.45.

R.G. Micklethwait.
